video:video.video:title: Easy Storyboard: the 90-second tour
video:video.video:description: A 90-second tour of Easy Storyboard, the free Claude Code skill that turns links, PDFs and docs into narrated, animated videos. The tour itself was made with the skill: script, voice, animation and render.

video:video.video:title: Character rigging in Easy Storyboard
video:video.video:description: Five rigged characters acting on a timeline: waving, looking at and pointing to a chart, changing mood, jumping and talking in speech bubbles.
